scope: Isolated Anvil 1874 and PostgreSQL; real local receipts and cryptographic wallet signatures, no World proof fabricated, no external funds
checks: Plans and checkout survive a fresh PostgreSQL store instance
Actual local token transfer + payer signature + exact receipt minted one living grant
Duplicate confirmation returned the existing checkout, without a second grant
A second checkout could not redeem the same real transaction
SDK public check sees the paid entitlement
Paid run used the bound worker and actual on-chain mandate capacity
A child with insufficient allocation was refused
On-chain revocation refused paid work and preserved credits
Provider received the full payment; one exact 0.1% fee persisted after retries and store restart
Mandate signatures for another chain were rejected before deployment
